manifest.caveat: session_init.tools stores names only, not historical descriptions/schemas. Most definitions recovered from installed @oh-my-pi source; find/wait reconstructed from the available current tool interface. manifest.encoding: Anthropic /v1/messages: system text blocks; assistant tool_use and signed thinking blocks; user tool_result blocks with verbatim content; adjacent same-role blocks merged; tool definitions as input_schema. Canonical input JSON retained separately. Native /v1/pi/stream rejected provider-qualified model selector.

variants.V1: Own archived prefix from R with every prior thinking/redactedThinking block removed.

manifest.thinkingFallback: On a thinking/signature rejection, retain the verbatim error and retry the same request with thinking.type=disabled; never fabricate historical thinking.
